identification: Three framed colour prints from Charles Crombie's 'Rules of Golf' series (Rules XIV, XV, XVI), signed in plate, gilt frames. Photos show later offset-type reproductions likely; original 1905 Perrier chromolithographs are a separate, higher-value item.

chrome_hint: eBay AU and UK sold + Terapeak: 'Crombie Rules of Golf print framed' and 'Charles Crombie golf print Perrier' (check sold, last 12 months, separate originals 1905 from reproductions, note single vs set of 3). Also Invaluable/LiveAuctioneers/Bonhams/Mullock's results for 'Crombie Rules of Golf'. WorthPoint 'Crombie golf rules print'.
viewing_check: Check for Perrier / Perrier & Cie publisher imprint and 1905 date in the plate margin, printing method (lithographic stone grain vs dot screen under a loupe), paper age, and frame backs for old labels. Dot-screen printing means reproduction.
